scope: two isolated x86_64 QEMU guests; real USBFS Special syscall-entry gate; not in-kernel execution or physical hardware
qemu_version:
QEMU emulator version 6.2.0 (Debian 1:6.2+dfsg-2ubuntu6.31)
Copyright (c) 2003-2021 Fabrice Bellard and the QEMU Project developers

server: console=ttyS0 panic=-1 RUSTUSB_QEMU_GUEST=1 rustusb.host_state_test=1 rustusb.role=server rustusb.operation=configuration rustusb.mode=eof rustusb.nonce=cr-v2-configuration-eof
client: console=ttyS0 panic=-1 RUSTUSB_QEMU_GUEST=1 rustusb.host_state_test=1 rustusb.role=client rustusb.operation=configuration rustusb.mode=eof rustusb.nonce=cr-v2-configuration-eof

server_checks: RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_BOOT role=server operation=configuration mode=eof nonce=cr-v2-configuration-eof kernel=6.8.0-106-generic
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_MANAGEMENT_READY: PASS role=server interface=eth0 carrier=1 attempts=42
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_ORIGINAL: PASS config=1 interfaces=2 alt0=0 alt1=1 drivers=cdc_ether node=root0600 direct_open=denied
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_SERVER_UID: PASS uid=1000 capabilities=0 tracer_root=true helper_separate=true
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_HELD: PASS syscall_entry=true kernel_handler_active_unproven=true pending=1 budget=256
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_CLOSED: PASS closing=true pending=2 budget=512 no_early_restore=true
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_RESTORED: PASS original_config_alt_drivers=true pending=0 queued=0 inflight=0 budget=0
client_checks: RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_BOOT role=client operation=configuration mode=eof nonce=cr-v2-configuration-eof kernel=6.8.0-106-generic
RUSTUSB_HOST_STATE_MANAGEMENT_READY: PASS role=client interface=eth0 carrier=1 attempts=42
